actualGlbCounts.method: Parse actual GLB v2 JSON chunks, traverse default-scene nodes and home-tier ancestry, count every mesh-node primitive; indexed triangles use index accessor count, non-indexed triangles use POSITION accessor count.
actualGlbCounts.countBasis: CPU static primitiveDrawCount; no material deduplication or assumption of one draw per material.
actualGlbCounts.triangleBasis: TRIANGLES count/3; TRIANGLE_STRIP/FAN max(0, count-2); submitted topology includes degenerate triangles.
